report_2006.title: Fast Solution of Richards' Equation for Flexible Soil Hydraulic Property Descriptions
report_2006.author: Peter J. Ross
report_2006.series: CSIRO Land and Water Science Report 39/06

source_code_search.evidence: A later Agricultural Water Management study explicitly thanks P.J. Ross for providing the source code of the Ross fast Richards solution, indicating author-distributed code existed, but this initial search did not locate a public authoritative repository or license statement.
source_code_search.admission_rule: Do not copy or adapt third-party Ross code into SWAP5 without explicit provenance and license. Reconstruct algorithm independently from citable method sources if no admissible code artifact is found.

independent_implementations_or_descendan.relevance: Uses a Ross-derived noniterative Richards water solver in a soil-atmosphere model; reports generally improved computation time and mass balance mostly below 0.002 m, with differences under some dry conditions.
